# Cotelo

> Cotelo provides agentic AI that automates conference planning. AI agents find sponsors that match an event's brand, source venues, and build the schedule.

Planners describe their event in plain words. Cotelo's agents research and rank sponsors and venues, draft the agenda, and present options. The planner approves every decision.

## How it works

- Brief: the planner describes topic, audience, size, dates, budget and brand.
- Review and approve: the planner sees a ranked shortlist of sponsors and venues and a draft schedule, approves what fits, and changes what does not.
- Share in one place: all approved details are published on one page for attendees, so no one has to collect information from separate sources.
